insert into t_short_term_pick_daily (trade_date, pick_phase, pick_type, priority, stock_code, stock_name, market, industry, concept, price, change_pct, total_cap, circ_cap, turnover_rate, volume_ratio, main_inflow, main_inflow_pct, outer_inner_ratio, lianban, seal_ratio, zhaban_count, zt_time_first, zt_count_60d, low_depth, vol_shrink, trend_ma_ok, gain_5d, gain_20d, score, behavior, behavior_evidence, priority_reason, confirm_signal, risk_note) values
(#{item.tradeDate}, #{item.pickPhase}, #{item.pickType}, #{item.priority}, #{item.stockCode}, #{item.stockName}, #{item.market}, #{item.industry}, #{item.concept}, #{item.price}, #{item.changePct}, #{item.totalCap}, #{item.circCap}, #{item.turnoverRate}, #{item.volumeRatio}, #{item.mainInflow}, #{item.mainInflowPct}, #{item.outerInnerRatio}, #{item.lianban}, #{item.sealRatio}, #{item.zhabanCount}, #{item.ztTimeFirst}, #{item.ztCount60d}, #{item.lowDepth}, #{item.volShrink}, #{item.trendMaOk}, #{item.gain5d}, #{item.gain20d}, #{item.score}, #{item.behavior}, #{item.behaviorEvidence}, #{item.priorityReason}, #{item.confirmSignal}, #{item.riskNote})
mapper.select: select p.* from t_short_term_pick_daily p left join t_short_term_experience e on e.trade_date = p.trade_date and e.stock_code = p.stock_code where p.trade_date between #{minDate} and #{maxDate} and e.id is null order by p.trade_date desc, p.pick_type asc, p.priority asc limit 40
mapper.insert: insert into t_short_term_experience (exp_date, exp_type, pick_type, trade_date, stock_code, stock_name, result_brief, summary, rule_hint, ai_raw) values (#{expDate}, #{expType}, #{pickType}, #{tradeDate}, #{stockCode}, #{stockName}, #{resultBrief}, #{summary}, #{ruleHint}, #{aiRaw})

insert into t_stock_basic (stock_code, stock_name, industry, concept_sectors) values
(#{s.stockCode}, #{s.stockName}, #{s.industry}, #{s.concept})
